data.long_meaning: The name Furaihah is derived from the Arabic root 'faraha', meaning 'to be happy or pleased'. This name evokes feelings of joy, contentment, and radiance. It is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Furaihah carries the meaning “Happy, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Furaihah usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
